snippet.title: DOGPILE | Surprise Release Developer Feature
snippet.description:
OUT NOW | Our roguelike deck builder about merging dogs into bigger dogs, is now out on PC and Mac! 

Build your deck of dogs, collect dogs with unique traits, experiment with Dog Tag modifiers, and create wild synergies as you stack, merge, and upgrade your pups. it's cute, chaotic, and remarkably addictive 🐶
---
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839300/Dogpile/
---
Dogpile is a collaboration between Studio Folly who made Gubbins and Real Bird Fake Bird, and Toot Games who are also making My Arms Are Longer Now!
